title: Magical and beautiful tour! Thank you.
text: I traveled alone to visit a friend at Christmas and out of curiosity I took this tour, the guide was wonderful, he took us to a beautiful market and told us many funny stories about Christmas in Barcelona, in reality it is very creative and its characters made us laugh on the journey, totally recommended!! They also gave us a very good gift for the price.
author: Olivia_M

title: Wonderful Historical Tour!
text: Our tour guide Kriztina was not only such a lovely human but incredibly knowledgeable on the history and legends of barcelona. We had a lot of fun roaming the streets and sitting at a local terrace having a glass of vermouth. Would recommend this to anyone who wants to learn more about the area they are travelling to!
author: Clara_T

title: The best historical tour 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼
text: Really enjoyed the Gothic Quarter tour, it was a highlight of my trip. The streets are beautiful and full of character, and the guide shared stories that made everything feel alive. We saw a few hidden spots I’d never find myself. It felt more like walking with a local than being on a tour.
author: Sightsee34399599934

title: Spectacular experience!
text: Walking through the old streets while hearing mysterious and fascinating stories made everything feel magical. Ending with a vermouth was the perfect touch. Such a unique and memorable experience!
author: faraonefoto

title: Full of hidden gems
text: The Gothic Quarter is full of hidden gems, and our guide brought the history to life with great stories. So many narrow streets to get “lost” in, but our guide made sure we found the best vermouth at the end
author: Ana_S

title: An excellent tour!
text: This wasn't the typical tour that you only hear history and legends about the most iconic places in Barcelona. The treats and especially the vermut were great! The guide Tony was not only professional, was lovable and funny. Definitely I recommend this tour.
author: Luke_V

title: Amazing!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: Such a fun experience! History, legends, absinthe and vermouth…everything was good!!! . Our guide Francisco made it unforgettable.
author: Christian_C
